name: Faint Echo
source:
A young man named Denys moves into a cheap apartment after landing a new job. At first, everything seems normal – but soon, he realizes that something is very wrong. Strange things begin to happen not only in his apartment, but throughout the entire building.

Denys finds himself entangled in a web of paranormal events – and now, he must uncover the truth and find a way to survive.

[From [url=https://agard.itch.io/faint-echo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫丹尼斯的年轻人找到新工作后搬进了一套廉价公寓。起初，一切看起来都很正常——但很快，他就意识到有些事情非常不对劲。奇怪的事情不仅发生在他的公寓里，而且遍布整栋大楼。

丹尼斯发现自己陷入了超自然事件的网络中 - 现在，他必须揭开真相并找到生存之道。

[来自[url=https://agard.itch.io/faint-echo]Itch.io[/url]]
